faqs.a:
(a)
Officers and agents.
The following persons, when acting in accordance with any city wildlife management
               plan as may from time to time be promulgated by the city, and in the course of the
               performance of their official duties, shall be deemed exempt from the provisions of
section 14-171
, cruelty,
section 62-51
, discharging firearms, and
section 62-56
, throwing missiles, of this Code:
(1)
Any federal, state or local peace officer including Colorado Division of Wildlife
               Officers and Arvada Animal Management Officers.
(2)
Any employee, agent, or contractor designated by the city to perform specific duties
               pursuant to any city wildlife management plan.
(b)
Police dogs.
Police dogs owned by federal, state, or local law enforcement agencies shall be deemed
               exempt from the provisions of this chapter while being used in the performance of
               the functions and duties of said agency.
(Code 1981, § 6-8; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998;
Ord. No. 4176, § 1, 8-17-2009
)
